description: This file defines the MemoryPooledCache class, which implements a pooled memory cache for stream messages in Orleans. It manages buffer pools, serialization, and eviction strategies for in-memory stream data, providing methods for adding, purging, and retrieving cached messages.

classes.name: MemoryPooledCache
classes.description: A generic class implementing a pooled cache for memory stream provider, supporting cache operations and message serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: Cursor
classes.description: An internal class implementing a cursor for iterating over cached messages.

methods.name: MemoryPooledCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the pooled cache with buffer pool, serializer, eviction strategy, and cache monitor.

methods.name: QueueMessageToCachedMessage
methods.description: Converts a MemoryMessageData object into a CachedMessage, including stream position and segment serialization.

methods.name: SerializeMessageIntoPooledSegment
methods.description: Serializes a message payload into a buffer segment, allocating new buffers as needed.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Creates a StreamPosition object from a MemoryMessageData.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of messages that can be added at once.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: Adds a list of batch containers to the cache after converting them into cached messages.

methods.name: TryPurgeFromCache
methods.description: Attempts to purge expired messages from the cache using the eviction strategy.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Returns a cursor for iterating over messages in a specific stream starting from a given token.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Indicates whether the cache is under memory pressure (always false here).

methods.name: GetBatchContainer
methods.description: Deserializes a cached message into a batch container for processing.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Returns a sequence token for a cached message.
